topNews.text: In the Land of Infrastructure Projects, Activists and Nature Lovers Saved Endangered Spoonbill Habitat
topNews.excerpt: Following 25 days of vigorous local campaigning, residents in the supposedly-totalitarian country of China succeeded in halting highway construction that would have plowed through mudflats which 49 species of bird rely on for dinner and rest. topNews.text: World’s Largest ‘Whale Graveyard’ Teems with Deep-Sea Life Including Species Unknown to Science
topNews.excerpt: Chinese scientists have discovered the world’s largest “whale graveyard” in a trench deep below the Indian Ocean—and it teems with life. topNews.text: Thawing Permafrost Not Only Emits CO2, It Absorbs it Too, Shows Landmark Study
